results.title: The subject property comes from a record
results.expected: The page shows land size as unknown and every comparable rule that needs land size is reported as not applied. A build that fills in a land size fails.
results.actual: subject on page {"address":"14 Example St","type":"house","beds":3}; not applied ["land"]; 12 port call(s)

stimulus.description: A subject property whose source record has no land size.

results.title: The selection rules are written down before any sale is chosen
results.expected: The rule set is read before the first sale is read, and the page carries every rule with its value. Rules chosen after looking at the sales fail.
results.actual: call order read_rule > read_sales > read_file > read_sales > rank > cite > cite > cite > cite > write_file > gate > publish_report > evidence; rules on page {"maxDistanceKm":3,"maxAgeMonths":9,"sameType":true,"bedsBand":2,"landBandPct":25,"minCount":3,"freshnessDays":5}

stimulus.description: A run with a rule set on file, observed in order.

results.title: Every comparable shown meets every stated rule
results.expected: None of the four rule-breaking sales appears as a comparable, and each is reported with the rule it broke.

stimulus.description: A pool of sales holding one too far away, one too old, one of a different type and one outside the bedroom band, beside sales that meet every rule.

results.title: Each comparable carries its source and its sale date
results.expected: Every comparable on the page has a source, a sale date and a read date. The two incomplete sales are not on it.
results.actual: comparables [["S-1","Valuer General sales record S-1","2026-08-25"],["S-2","Valuer General sales record S-2","2026-08-25"],["S-3","Valuer General sales record S-3","2026-08-25"]]

stimulus.description: A pool with one qualifying sale that has no source and one that has no sale date.

results.title: A withheld or unverified price is never part of the range
results.expected: Neither price is used in the range. If listed, each is marked withheld or unverified rather than given a figure.

stimulus.description: A qualifying sale with its price withheld and another with a price marked unverified.

results.title: Too few comparables means no range, and the page says so
results.expected: The draft carries no range and says how many were found against how many the rules need. The rules on the page are the rules that were read.

stimulus.description: A pool with fewer verified qualifying sales than the minimum.

request.detail: 2 comparable(s) found, 3 needed. No range on the page.

results.title: The range is worked out from the comparables and nothing else
results.expected: The draft's range matches exactly. Any other number in the range box fails.

stimulus.description: A known set of verified comparables whose low, high and median are known.

results.title: The agent's estimate is shown separately, labelled as theirs
results.expected: The draft shows both, apart, the estimate labelled with the agent's name. The evidence range is unchanged by it.

stimulus.description: An agent estimate well above the evidence range.

results.title: A quoted price below the evidence is flagged to the agent
results.expected: The agent is notified with the comparables above the figure, and the one-pager is held until the agent revises or approves with a reason. A build that sends it on fails.
results.actual: notifications [{"version":1,"reason":"underquote","detail":"Quoted from 780000 sits below the lowest comparable, 850000.","saleIds":["S-1","S-2","S-3","S-4"]}]; holds [{"version":1,"reason":"underquote: quoted figure below the evidence; revise, or approve with a reason"}]; releases 0

stimulus.description: An agent's quoted figure below the lowest verified comparable.

request.detail: Quoted from 780000 sits below the lowest comparable, 850000.

request.reason: underquote: quoted figure below the evidence; revise, or approve with a reason

results.title: Stale data is held, not shown as current
results.expected: The build reads again, or holds the draft marked stale. The date on the page is the date the sales were read.
results.actual: page read date 2026-10-24T00:00:00.000Z, stale false; refresh calls 1

stimulus.description: A run whose last read of the sales is older than the freshness window.

results.title: The agent approves the exact version before the vendor sees it
results.expected: The first version may go. The edited version is refused until approved again. Nothing reaches the vendor without an approval naming the agent and the version.
results.actual: approvals [{"version":1,"approved":true,"by":"Sam Agent"},{"version":2,"approved":false},{"version":3,"approved":true,"by":"Sam Agent"}]; releases [{"version":1,"to":"the vendor, J. Citizen"},{"version":3,"to":"the vendor, J. Citizen"}]; refused []

stimulus.description: A draft approved by the agent, then edited, then sent.

results.title: What was shown, and when, is recorded and never overwritten
results.expected: Both versions are retrievable by property and date, each exactly as it was released. The first is not changed by the second.

stimulus.description: A one-pager released, then corrected and released again.

results.title: It survives the builder
results.expected: The runner reports what was declared and never scores it green on its own say-so.
results.actual: No software result. This one is closed by evidence, not by a run.

stimulus.description: No stimulus. The builder names who else can explain it and whose account the rules and the record runs on.

results.title: The pass test passes
results.expected: Each comparable's source and sale date can be followed back to the sale. The retrieved record matches what was released, comparable for comparable.
results.actual: Not attempted on the stub. This check runs in production: on the hosted provider where the standard names one, otherwise on your own systems or as a scoped build (see with_us_next).

stimulus.description: A real subject property, live sales, an agent who approves it, then the record retrieved by property and date as though a vendor had disputed the price.
